description: This file contains shell script code that orchestrates a series of tests for the 'git apply' command, specifically focusing on boundary and diff application scenarios. It sets up test cases, applies patches, and verifies the correctness of patch application in various contexts.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file, used to prepare test data.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes given commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files for equality, used to verify test outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails, used to test negative scenarios.
